npcs.name: Yuzu
idle: Lovely day for a stroll.
The notice board has news.
Mochi, welcome back to the square.
party: The lanterns make your yard feel magical.
Stay for one more dance, Mochi.

barks.text: Mochi, welcome back to the square.
The lanes are sleeping. Walk softly.
There you are, hero of the village.

lines.text: The lanterns mark the loop. North to the board, south toward home.
Night watch is quiet. The board can wait until dawn.
Pip hops, Momo bakes, Juniper posts. Say hello when you pass.
You helped every neighbour. The square feels safer with you in it.

npcs.name: Momo
idle: Fresh bread smells best at dawn.
Have you tried the bench by the lantern?
party: I brought cinnamon cocoa in a thermos.

barks.text: The oven's warm. Stay a minute.
Dough's sleeping. Come back at dawn.
My cottage smells like cinnamon now.

lines.text: Cinnamon first, then the stew carrot. Don't rush a loaf.
I punch dough at first light. That's the secret.
The lantern bench is the best seat in the square. Bring a bun.
Sable's roof doesn't leak. I sleep with the window toward the path.

npcs.name: Pip
idle: Bet I can hop higher than you!
I found a shiny pebble over there.
party: Trick or treat! Smell my candy bag!
Knock over three pumpkins for extra ruckus!
Want a spooky sticker? I hid one by the hay.

barks.text: Race you to the lantern!
I'm supposed to be asleep… hi anyway.

lines.text: If you flop right after a hop you bounce twice. I counted.
My smooth pebble lives in my pocket now. Don't tell Yuzu I lick it.
Three crates in a row! I'm still grinning. Let's mess up the park later.

npcs.name: Hana
idle: The meadow pumpkins are almost ready.
Mind the mud near the river.
party: I carved smiley faces on the big pumpkins.
The scarecrow is just for fun, promise!
Take a ghost sheet from the fence.

barks.text: Mind the mud, Mochi.
Juniper's parcel had the seed list. Thank you.

lines.text: The meadow pumpkins like sun and a little gossip. I talk to them.
You checked the frost for me. The vines are stretching east now.
That catalogue is a treasure. Next season I'll try the striped squash.

npcs.name: Kiko
idle: The reeds hide the best minnows.
Quiet steps, Mochi.

barks.text: Quiet steps. The minnows scare easy.

lines.text: Stand still and the river tells you where the minnows hide.
I can read the ripples again. Next time I'll tie them to my hat.
Stand on the bank and cast with Go. Minnows, silver fish, lazy carp — the river chooses.
That silver fish was perfect. The reeds approve of your quiet paws.

npcs.name: Tofu
idle: The springs steam nicest at dusk.
Soak your paws when you can.

barks.text: Steam's up. Paws in when you like.
Dusk makes the water gold.

lines.text: Stay until your whiskers droop. That's how you know it's working.
You soaked like a local. Come back when the east road is dusty.

npcs.name: Juniper
idle: The board gets a new notice every morning.
Parcels, notices, gossip. I carry all three.
Come back tomorrow for a fresh job.
party: The cobweb cape by the gate is free to wear.

barks.text: Board's got a notice if you need a job.
I hang the last notice at dusk. Sleep well.

lines.text: A new job every morning. Read it here or ask me — I posted it.
Parcels, notices, gossip. I carry all three, usually in that order.
Hana got her seed catalogue. You run faster than my cart.

npcs.name: Sable
idle: Good land down here. Cheap, too.
Measure twice, hammer once.
A cottage first. Then we talk cafés.

barks.text: Measure twice, Mochi.
Hammer's down. Talk in the morning.
That cottage sits true. Proud of you.

lines.text: South meadow is flat and dry. Buy a sign, then we raise a roof.
Momo's flour sacks are already inside. Door toward the path was the right call.
A stall and a second plot. The valley will shop here. Café when you're ready.

npcs.name: Porter
idle: All aboard — when you're ready.
Meadow line runs east from here.
Keep clear of the rails, paws.

barks.text: Platform's clear. Pick a stop.
Last train's tucked in. Morning runs start at dawn.

lines.text: Board here, pick a destination, and hop off when we stop. No swimming required.
West to forest and mine, east to meadow and springs. Junction is under your feet.

npcs.name: Nori
idle: Watch your head in the shaft.
Ore sings if you listen.
Lantern first, then the pick.

barks.text: Mine mouth's open. Mind the steps.
Shaft's dark. Come back with daylight.

lines.text: Portal's right on the mouth. Ore sits near the entrance; lanterns farther in.
That chunk you pulled will keep Sable happy for a week.

npcs.name: Biscuit
idle: Flour on my whiskers means the oven is honest.
Pastries taste better after a café visit.

barks.text: Smell that crust? Fresh as the square.
Dough rests overnight. Come back at dawn.

lines.text: Momo taught me the cinnamon trick. I just keep the fire steady.
You sat under the café lanterns. Next time try the pastry tray.
That warm pastry found the right paws. Come back when the tray is full again.

npcs.name: Ms. Clover
idle: Chalk dust and good questions: that is a school.
Take any free desk.

barks.text: Welcome, Mochi! Take a seat at a free desk for today's lesson.
Lessons are done for the day, but you can still take a seat.
A gold star student! Pip will be jealous.

lines.text: Sit at any free desk and I will ask three questions. Five CappyCoin for every right answer.
One lesson a day. Get all three right and you earn a gold star sticker.
Bean asks a hundred questions a day. Sprout mostly draws trains. Both are lovely.

npcs.name: Bean
idle: Is it snack time yet?

barks.text: Psst! The answer is usually the one that sounds most like a capybara.
I got a gold star once. It was for sitting still.

lines.text: Ms. Clover knows everything. Even how many legs a spider has!

npcs.name: Sprout
idle: I am drawing the train. It has nine wheels.

barks.text: Want to see my drawing? It's the little red train.
Shh, I'm counting stations. Six!

lines.text: The train goes Home, Village, Meadow, Hot springs, Forest and the Mine. Choo!

npcs.name: Dr. Hazel
idle: An apple a day, and a warm soak on Sundays.

barks.text: Hello, Mochi! Hop by the beds for a quick check-up.
Late shift. The check-up bed is still open.

lines.text: Stand between the beds and I will give you a once-over. Healthy capybaras run faster for a while!
Come back after a few hours for another one.
Soak at the hot springs, eat your greens, and don't lick the frog potions.

npcs.name: Nurse Poppy
idle: Sign in at the desk, please!

barks.text: Welcome to the hospital! Dr. Hazel is by the beds.
Mind the floor, I just mopped it.

lines.text: No waiting today. Dr. Hazel sees everyone, even Bean when he eats too much cake.

npcs.name: Maple
idle: Fresh bottles on the back shelves.

barks.text: Welcome to the general store! Step up to the counter to shop.
I stock every brew from the manor, bottled fresh.
If your purse is light, pocket the gold sparks outside. I'll pay for a straightened crate too.

lines.text: Bounce, swift, glimmer, cloud sip, and the ribbit hex for pranksters. Pay at the counter.

npcs.name: Lulu
idle: Every outfit deserves a twirl.

barks.text: Darling, that fur needs a scarf! Come to the counter.
Try the mirror by the window after you buy something.

lines.text: Hats, scarves, bow ties, a flower crown... Buy it here, then wear it from the Wardrobe.

npcs.name: Chief Ember
idle: Ready for anything, day or night.

barks.text: Welcome to the fire station! Try the pole — everyone does.
Thanks again for Mittens. You're one of us now.

lines.text: Pole in the corner, bell by the wall, truck out front. Ring the bell if you want to see Flint jump.
Never leave a lantern by the hay, and always know two ways out of a room.

npcs.name: Flint
idle: Polishing the truck again.

barks.text: That truck out front? I shine it every morning.
Ding ding! Oh... that was just in my head.

lines.text: Ladder, hose, siren. The siren is my favourite part, don't tell the Chief.

npcs.name: Sergeant Barley
idle: All quiet in the village.

barks.text: Afternoon, Mochi. Anything to report?
The village is safer with helpers like you.

lines.text: Mostly lost mittens and runaway pumpkins. The lost-and-found box is by the wall.
If you find something shiny on your walks, bring it here.

npcs.name: Officer Dot
idle: On patrol. Well, indoor patrol.

barks.text: Keep your paws clean and your pockets checked!
Sergeant Barley makes the best cocoa.

lines.text: I walk the square every evening. Mostly I say hello to Yuzu.
